originals.citation: Steiner, D. D., & Gilliland, S. W. (1996). Fairness reactions to personnel selection techniques in France and the United States. Journal of Applied Psychology, 81(2), 134-141.

quote: Its first objective was to shed further light on cultural differences in applicant reactions to selection techniques by partially replicating a study by ), who obtained ratings of process favorability for ten different procedures from two groups of French and American students.
notes: Citation elided in abstract, but the French/American ten-procedure favorability study is Steiner & Gilliland (1996).
